about: Board workloads for the remote CPU hunt (spec 2026-10-29-cpu-hunt-remote sections 5.1/5.2). GENERATED by tools/pick_workloads.py from the law-driven sweep (build/sweep.exe); hand entries are kind=hand and the gestures. rows_x1000: one value per kRevaTable row, x1000 of the normalised pot value. Gesture steps: at `block` (from the gesture's start) set `row` to `value_x1000` through the pot path; row -1 = a MOD key press, row -2 = SHIFT held + MOD press (clear_mod_layer). `bastian` is captured in Task 7.

sweep.note: pass 1: --corners --random 200 --seed k (k = pairing index 1..16) --seconds 10 --reps 3; pass 2 (these CSVs): the top 20 of pass 1 by max_ns with silent_frac < 0.5 plus the 4 corners, --seconds 100 --reps 3; --input noise; 4 pairings at a time on the desktop
sweep.material: BBD decks: excite_other_deck held across the switch; SAMPLER decks: REC latched for a 2500-block settle, then released; audio in: low-passed noise about -12 dBFS
